name: sensitive-query-redacted-landing
description: Default landingPageFormat 'url' removes email, token and phone (and a _<word> suffix key) from the stored landing page; UTMs and the click ID are kept in URL order with their raw encoding, and the signal is unchanged.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT FIX (#83, plugin parity click-trail-handler#232): sensitive query keys never reach ft_/lt_landing_page. Deliberate change to ruling #12 (full href): privacy fix, not opt-in. Semver: behavior change on a default; recorded in specs/003-sensitive-query-redaction. CLASSIFIER_VERSION and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged (channel logic untouched).
